title: IINTS-AF SDK
description:
Python simulation framework for testing insulin-dosing algorithms against virtual patients under degraded data and device conditions. Includes ODE patient models (Bergman- and Hovorka-style), explicit CGM and insulin-pump device models, a machine-readable formula registry with evidence classes, a deterministic independent safety supervisor, and provenance-tracked experiment arms.

Research and educational software. Not a medical device. Not clinically validated. Must not be used to determine a real insulin dose.
